named_next_action: fresh observation in a domain this mission has not touched, chosen by a stated rule rather than by comfort
stated_rule: Per D083, candidate domains must be truly untested by this mission's view-count principle. Boundary condition: principle works on platforms with per-request metadata (view_count/download_count/star_count) where need-related content has systematic activity advantages.
decision: Extensive domain exploration complete. The view-count principle's boundary conditions are now well-mapped: supported on code/package repositories, does not generalize to Q&A forums, ML model registries, fault code forums, or general-interest platforms. Classification remains the primary challenge on text-based platforms. G1 (>=30 per arm) is the most common gate failure across all domains.
continuation: Select a truly fresh domain for the next view-count principle experiment, chosen by the stated rule rather than by comfort. After 27+ domains tested, a truly fresh domain would be one not in the tested category list. Possible fresh approaches: (1) a platform with explicit need/random categorization built into its structure, (2) a domain where per-request metadata naturally separates need-from-random content, or (3) synthesize existing evidence into a boundary map document and propose a prioritized next-domain list.
